## Evidence and boundaries

- Claims and known-test references:
- Validator result and version:
- What was not tested, blocked, or failed (including recovered failures):
- Source, license and privacy review:
- Recovery and flash-plan review, if relevant (no agent flashing in public v1):

## Review

- [ ] I inspected the entire diff for private identifiers, credentials and blobs.
- [ ] I preserved third-party licenses and provenance.
- [ ] I limited claims to the recipe, artifact set and variants actually tested.
- [ ] I understand automated screening is partial and logs are not attestation.
- [ ] I request human maintainer review; agent recommendations are advisory.
